description_en: Modifies the SSL link configuration of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS实例的SSL链路配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-ssl --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --connection-string rm-uf6wjk50000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceSSL

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The internal or public endpoint for which you want to create or update the server certificate
parameters.help_zh: 需要创建或更新服务器证书的内网或外网连接地址
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable SSL. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭SSL，取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The type of certificate for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
aliyun (default): Alibaba Cloud certificate.
custom: Custom certificate.
This parameter is required when SSLEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL和PostgreSQL云盘版实例的证书类型，取值：
aliyun（默认值）：使用阿里云证书
custom：使用自定义证书
SSLEnabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: ca_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom certificate content of the server for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks.

This parameter is required when CAType is set to custom
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL和PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器自定义证书内容。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_cert

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the server certificate for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks.

This parameter is required when CAType is set to custom
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL和PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书私钥。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the client certification authority (CA) public key for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例是否启用客户端授权机构公钥，取值：
1：启用
0：关闭
parameters.name: client_ca_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The client certificate authorization authority public key for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks.

This parameter is required when ClientCAEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥。

ClientCAEbabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: client_ca_cert

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the client certificate revocation list (CRL) for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable.

This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例是否启用客户端吊销证书，取值：
1：启用
0：关闭

仅当ClientCAEnabled为1时，才允许配置
parameters.name: client_crl_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The client certificate revocation certificate file for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks.

This parameter is required when ClientCrlEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端吊销证书文件。

ClientCrlEnabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: client_cert_revocation_list

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL 12 and later)

This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的认证方法取值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

仅当ClientCAEnabled为1时，才允许配置
parameters.name: acl

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method for the replication permission of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL 12 and later)
This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的replication权限认证方法，取值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）
仅当ClientCAEnabled为1时，才允许配置
parameters.name: replication_acl

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. Valid values:

1: Enabled.
0: Not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL、SQL Server实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html，取值：

1：开启。
0：未开启
parameters.name: force_encryption

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Connection requests from clients with a TLS version lower than the specified version are rejected. Valid values: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2.

For example, if you set this parameter to 1.1, the server accepts only connection requests from clients that use TLS 1.1 or TLS 1.2. Connection requests from clients that use TLS 1.0 are rejected
parameters.help_zh:
指定SQL Server实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html，低于该版本将被拒绝连接。当前支持1.0、1.1、1.2。

例如：选择1.1表示服务端仅接受TLS 1.1和1.2协议版本的客户端连接请求，通过TLS 1.0建立连接的客户端会被拒绝连接
parameters.name: tls_version

parameters.help_en:
The custom certificate content for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Only the `pfx` certificate format is supported.
Public endpoint: `oss-<RegionId>.aliyuncs.com:<BucketName>:<CertificateFileName (certificate file extension)>`
Internal endpoint: `oss-<RegionId>-internal.aliyuncs.com:<BucketName>:<CertificateFileName (certificate file extension)>`
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例的用户自定义证书内容，证书格式仅支持`pfx`。
公网地址：`oss-<地域ID>.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket名称>:<证书文件名称（带文件后缀）>`
内网地址：`oss-<地域ID>-internal.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket名称>:<证书文件名称（带文件后缀）>`
parameters.name: certificate

parameters.help_en: The password of the custom certificate for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
parameters.help_zh: SQL Server实例的用户自定义证书密码
parameters.name: pass_word
